annotations.description:
Memory usage on host {{ $labels.instance }} is critically high, with {{ printf "%.2f" $value }}% of total memory used.
This exceeds the threshold of 90%.
Current memory free: {{ with printf `windows_memory_physical_free_bytes{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}
or
windows_os_physical_memory_free_bytes{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}` | query | first | value | humanize }}{{ . }}{{ end }}.
Total memory: {{ with printf `windows_cs_physical_memory_bytes{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}
or
windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}` | query | first | value | humanize }}{{ . }}{{ end }}.
Consider investigating processes consuming high memory or increasing available memory.
annotations.summary: High memory usage on Windows host.
